To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the m-best 3D assignment algorithm is a very efficient algorithm for solving a wide variety of data association problems, and that it can be improved in several ways.

1) a nonintrusive algorithm switching mechanism based on a problem-sparsity threshold can be used to dynamically switch between two different 1D assignment algorithms, and 2), using a parallelization of both the m-best partition and the data association interface tasks, a multilevel data association algorithm can be developed that provides efficient solutions to the m-best two-dimension (2D) data association problem.
we present a nonintrusive algorithm switching mechanism and multilevel task parallelization for the m-best 3D assignment framework.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the efficiency and performance of the m-best 1D and 2D assignment methods.
the development of a dynamically adaptable m-best 3-D assignment algorithm, which is capable of efficiently solving the data association problem for various types of data association algorithms.
the efficient solution to data association problems, including JPDA and MHT.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed improvements to the mbest 2D assignment approach are effective and efficient.

the m-best 1D and 2D assignment frameworks, as implemented in the current version of the Joint Probabilistic Data Association Filter (JPDAF) software library, are highly suitable for solving the data association problem in a variety of applications, including air traffic surveillance, multiple target tracking, radar tracking, and multiple sensor fusion.
our improvements to the mbest 2D assignment approach enable more efficient solutions for both sparse and dense tracking scenarios.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have improved the efficiency of the m-best 3D assignment algorithm by a factor of 3.3 to 4.5 times.

we have demonstrated a dynamically adaptive m-best 2-dimensional (2D)-assignment algorithm, which provides efficient solutions to the multiple data association problems generated in the framework of m-best 2-assignment.

we provide a highly efficient m-best 2d assignment framework, which is able to solve numerous 2D data association problems in real time, and which is able to provide efficient solutions to both JPDA and MHT problems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the m-best 3D assignment algorithm can be efficiently solved using a combination of problem-specific 2D assignment switching and multilevel task parallelization.
the m-best 3D assignment algorithm, which is the most widely used algorithm in tracking, is not necessarily the most efficient.

a dynamically adaptable m-best 3-D assignment algorithm and a multilevel data parallelization of the 3-D data association interface task will be needed for efficient solutions to the multiple 3-D assignment problems generated in an m-best 3D assignment framework.
